svg.aria-label: A human and precise maker machines build, test, revise and teach the next machine
svg.title: A shared workshop that learns from each build
svg.desc: Original cinematic sci-fi workshop illustration. Human insight enters a warm input station. A precision maker arm constructs a small successor machine, a test reveals blocked access, feedback changes the joint and reinforcement, and a second anchored station receives the improved design. Shared source knowledge, including a MANUFACTURER GUIDE with source, edition, limits, is represented by the luminous design core. An eight-second conceptual story, not a hardware simulation or automatic model training; Human-reviewed contributions remain the real improvement mechanism.
